status: Established autoregressive identity and implementation-specific consequences; not new algorithm/theorem

symbols.X: Frozen user request, actual scene views/state and allowed past tool results
symbols.D: Recorded or self-generated explicit decision proposal
symbols.w: Original per-target-token coefficient; no per-stage reweighting

identity.weighted_objective: L_joint=-sum_{i,t in D_i or A_i} w_it log p_theta(z_it|X_i,z_i,<t). Missing-D units contain only A.
identity.derivation: Partitioning the token sum into D and A terms does not create a new objective. For deterministic causal forwards, identical serialized prefixes, identical target coefficients and one common optimizer update, separate teacher-forced D and A forwards have the same total objective and gradient as the joined sequence. With stochastic layers equality requires matched stochastic computation or an appropriately stated expectation, not an unconditional per-run claim.
identity.inference_conditions: Stopping at D and resuming can preserve the autoregressive continuation only with exactly the same token/vision prefix and generation rule. A new system prompt, inserted host token, changed budgets/RNG or numerical cache behavior can change the result.

current_code_evidence.meaning: Current split policy is not merely an equivalent scheduling refactor of native continuous generation. Results estimate a training+prompt+deployment treatment unless these components are controlled.

comparison.purpose: Whether learning is needed at all
Whether shared geometry/tools and extra candidates explain gains; full-generation version still pending
Extra source supervision without inference-time D conditioning
Ordinary continuous D+A SFT/inference using identical recorded target tokens/weights, no new decisions
Explicit D stage followed by A conditioned on self-generated D; compared at actual total cost

material_result.full_multimodal_encoding: 13/24 units encoded with actual five-view processor; 11 missing units retained; 8/10 decision-supervised units encoded
material_result.native_joint_policy: implemented in shared production backend; executed using archived-token replay, not model inference

interpretation: A gain over direct-A but not ordinary joint-D+A supports ordinary rationale-conditioned learning, not the special two-stage mechanism.
A gain over joint-D+A must survive matched observations, ordinary search, full-room quality and total cost; it does not automatically establish novelty.
No loss function change or new name resolves the missing evidence of independent three-dimensional benefit.

primary_source.finding: Its SFT already trains a continuous think/answer placement sequence using token-level CE. This limits claims that reason-before-placement or joint supervision alone are new.

schedule.update_rule: Accumulate original weighted CE over every component of the same complete corpus before one optimizer update; identical number of updates, not identical number of microbatches. OriginalMassTrainer compensation supports variable component counts; a new 24-unit full-data training run has not been executed.
schedule.incomplete_data: Do not train the available 13-unit subset as though it were the frozen corpus.
schedule.after_eos: All 24 serialized targets include tokens after native EOS. They remain part of the identical supervised material; inference replay terminates at first EOS. This formatting supervision is not a design-quality signal.

deployment_treatment.joint: One continuous call on raw common observations; may output a recorded-style D then A or A alone. No forced D for missing-D units. No host separator or phase system instruction. Same total output/context/time budget; one call charged.
deployment_treatment.split: Two calls, phase-specific instructions, host-framed D and stage caps. Paired inference always requests D even for 14 units without recorded D supervision.
deployment_treatment.causal_limit: This comparison estimates a complete training/deployment protocol contrast. It cannot isolate semantic decision quality from prompts, phase boundaries, token allocation or missing-D support. A semantic-content claim additionally needs a same-format control without decision content; no fabricated D labels are introduced here.
deployment_treatment.scope: Learned intervention is currently furniture-stage policy; floor, wall, ceiling and manipuland completion remain shared. Final output is required to be a complete room. This is not a claim of learning every generation stage.
